Advanced Liquidity Lending Solutions

Welcome to 💧 Liquid Protocol — the pioneering platform for liquidity providers on the Ethereum network. Fully compatible with UNISWAP V2, our platform guarantees a safe and assured profit on deposits over an indefinite period.

Three Phases of Liquid Protocol:

Liquidity by Treasury

  • Funded by the coins taxes.
  • Borrow from the Treasury to use as liquidity for ERC20 tokens on UNISWAP V2.
  • Fixed rate guaranteed, varying options depend on market and lenders.
  • Costs: Borrowing 1ETH for 1 month costs 0.1ETH. For detailed rates, see our formula provided.

Liquidity by Lenders

  • Stake your ETH and lend liquidity for 75% of the generated revenue.
  • Lender role: Stake ETH, earn revenue, 25% goes to the protocol.
  • Borrower role: Borrow ETH at the lenders rate. No token taxes.

Coming Soon

  • Buy / sell locked liquidities.
  • Sellers can set a value lower than the liquidity they are selling.
  • Seller benefits: Get immediate funds by selling locked liquidity.
  • Buyer benefits: Secure a future return on a present-day investment.
